The Farplains stretch far across the island, ranging from the rich fertile soil of the Valedayn fields to the snow drifts of the Tundrus. Herd 
beasts migrating to the flora in bloom and in tandem, their pursuing predators picking off the weak fauna that fall behind. Beyond 
endless grasses, these lands harbor many unique resources. From the glistening jelly mounds of ooradew that eradicates infection and 
invigorates healing, to clattering pallid bonestalk reeds which make for incredible building material as they are pliable to bend in any 
direction without breaking. Besides what may grow among the fields, it is often the dessicated remains of beasts that hold the greatest 
riches, though only a Traveler ready to fend off the many scavengers can ever hope to claim them.
